summary: Verified Permisos → Novedades rename + new Teletrabajo type end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_novedades.py — POST /api/leave-requests with type 'telework' creates a pending request; it appears in GET /api/leave-requests. GET /api/reports/stats returns leaves.by_type with vacation/medical/normal/telework (int, telework >= 1). GET /api/dashboard/novedades returns {today:[], upcoming:[]} shape, items are approved-only (cross-checked via GET /api/leave-requests as admin), today items satisfy start<=today<=end, upcoming items have start>today and are ascending-sorted by start_date; a newly admin-approved future telework (start=today+21) is immediately found in upcoming. Endpoint requires auth (401/403 without token). Frontend (mobile 390x844): Login screen shows the feature chip 'Registra novedades' (login.tsx L31). After login (both admin1@conactivos.com and juan.perez@conactivos.com): Home card testID='novedades-card' is labeled 'Novedades' and shows '0 hoy · 3 próximas'. Tap → /novedades (back-btn works). /novedades header 'Novedades', two sections testID='novedades-today' titled 'Novedades de hoy' + testID='novedades-upcoming' titled 'Próximas novedades'. Teletrabajo novedades are visible as green 'Teletrabajo' badges on cards. Second home card 'Por aprobar' routes to /solicitudes. Solicitudes screen header 'Novedades'; '+' testID='open-new-leave-btn' opens 'Nueva Solicitud' modal with 'Tipo de Novedad' label and 4 type buttons in a 2x2 grid: leave-type-vacation / leave-type-medical / leave-type-normal / leave-type-telework (y-positions pair exactly, verified via bounding boxes). submit-leave-btn 'Crear Solicitud' present. Reportes screen (admin) shows sections 'Personal', 'Novedades' (Total de Novedades = 11) and 'Novedades por Tipo' including a 'Teletrabajo' row (word 'Permisos' appears exactly 1x as the label of the 'normal' type, which matches the spec).
